description: Timbermaw Ally Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done. Requirements: - Deadwood Warrior x 6 - Deadwood Pathfinder x 6 - Deadwood Gardener x 6
name: Timbermaw Ally
